facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog post on attracting customer attention says it shares 5 tips for capturing consumer attention.
facts.quote: we’re sharing 5 tips for attracting consumer attention

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that the window for grabbing a person's attention is short and that people will move on if the ad does not capture them within the first few seconds.
facts.quote: If you don’t capture it within the first few seconds, they will move on.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that ads on connected TV (CTV) are not skippable.
facts.quote: And, ads on CTV aren’t skippable.
